detailed_description: The Frosted Glass Effect tool applies a whole-image blur effect to an uploaded image directly in the browser. Choose an image file, then adjust the blur intensity with the 0 to 50 pixel slider or use the Light, Medium, and Heavy presets for a quick starting point. The preview is drawn on a canvas and uses the browser blur filter across the full image, so you can see the result before downloading. When the image looks right, export the blurred version as a PNG. This is useful for quick background artwork, UI mockups, covers, and visual accents. The tool works with one blur setting for the full image, without extra overlays, region tools, edge preservation controls, color tint controls, or server processing.
usage_steps: Choose an image file from your device.
Select the Light, Medium, or Heavy preset if you want a quick blur level.
Adjust the blur intensity slider from 0 to 50 pixels.
Review the canvas preview of the full image.
Refine the blur strength until the background or artwork feels right.
Download the result as a PNG.
usage_examples: Create a softly blurred image for a presentation slide background.
Prepare a frosted-glass-style visual for a website mockup.
Blur a photo before placing text over it in a design draft.
Download a PNG version of the effect for a cover image or interface prototype.

faqs.question: Does it blur the whole image or only part of it?
faqs.answer: It blurs the full image. The current page does not include region selection or masking controls.

faqs.question: Which controls are available?
faqs.answer: You can choose Light, Medium, or Heavy presets and manually set blur intensity from 0 to 50 pixels.

faqs.question: Which format does it download?
faqs.answer: The result downloads as a PNG file with the selected blur intensity in the filename.

faqs.question: Is the image uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. The image is read and processed in the browser with canvas.
